hooks.text: A cosmic explosion two billion light-years away warped Earth's atmosphere.
Could an explosion two billion light-years away physically strike Earth?
A blast from deep space physically warped our planet's atmosphere.

title: The Explosion That Warped Earth's Atmosphere
description: In 2022, a gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star was so powerful it physically altered our atmosphere from two billion light-years away.

beats.text: A cosmic explosion two billion light-years away warped Earth's atmosphere.
beats.visual: Gamma-ray burst radiation hitting Earth's ionosphere, artist concept, 2022

beats.text: The blast started when a massive star collapsed into a black hole.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of a massive star collapsing into a black hole with a jet
queries: star collapsing into black hole jet
gamma ray burst collapsar artist concept

beats.text: It fired a particle jet at nearly light speed toward us.
beats.visual: Scientific diagram of a narrow relativistic jet pointed directly at Earth, 2022
queries: relativistic jet pointing at earth diagram

beats.text: Orbiting space telescopes were instantly blinded by the intense radiation.
beats.visual: Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope in Earth orbit, NASA artist concept, 2022
queries: Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope NASA illustration
Swift observatory gamma ray burst artist

beats.text: This event was 70 times brighter than any burst ever recorded.
beats.visual: XMM-Newton image of X-ray dust rings around GRB 221009A, 2022

beats.text: The wave physically ionized the top layers of our atmosphere.
beats.visual: Diagram of Earth's atmosphere highlighting the ionized ionosphere layer

beats.text: It even jammed longwave radio signals on the ground.
beats.visual: Scientific illustration of radio waves reflecting off a disturbed ionosphere

beats.text: A strike this powerful only happens once every 10,000 years.
beats.visual: Gemini South observatory under a starry night sky in Chile, 2022

beats.text: Yet we physically felt an explosion two billion light-years away.
beats.visual: Deep space photograph of the constellation Sagitta showing distant stars
